_help: Edit titles/text freely. Numbering is automatic. Add or remove items in any section.

rules.title: Play fairly
rules.text: Using cheats, hacked clients, macros, autoclickers, scripts, or any other unfair advantage is not allowed.

rules.title: Respect Everyone
rules.text: Harassment, toxicity, discrimination, or intentionally provoking others is prohibited.

rules.title: No Exploiting
rules.text: Abuse of bugs, glitches, or unintended mechanics is not allowed. Report them to staff instead.

rules.title: No Impersonation
rules.text: Pretending to be a staff member, content creator, or another player is prohibited.

rules.title: Chat Responsibly
rules.text: Spam, excessive caps, command flooding, or disruptive behavior in chat is not allowed.

rules.title: Listen to Staff
rules.text: Follow staff instructions. If you disagree with a decision, contact staff respectfully instead of arguing publicly.

rules.title: Use Common Sense
rules.text: If an action gives you an unfair advantage or negatively affects others, don't do it.

rules.title: Be Respectful
rules.text: Treat all members with respect. Harassment, hate speech, and personal attacks are not allowed.

rules.title: No Spam
rules.text: Avoid repeated messages, excessive emojis, unnecessary pings, or other disruptive behavior.

rules.title: No Advertising
rules.text: Sharing server invites, advertisements, or self-promotion without permission is not allowed.

rules.title: Keep It Appropriate
rules.text: NSFW, graphic, or otherwise inappropriate content is prohibited.

rules.title: No Impersonation
rules.text: Do not pretend to be another member, staff member, or public figure.

rules.title: Stay On Topic
rules.text: Use channels for their intended purpose and avoid derailing conversations.

rules.title: Follow Staff Instructions
rules.text: Staff decisions should be respected. Appeals and concerns can be discussed through the proper channels.

rules.title: No Scams or Malicious Content
rules.text: Sending harmful links, scam attempts, or misleading content will result in immediate action.

notice: Rules may change at any time. It's your responsibility to check this page and the Discord rules channel regularly.
penalties: Violations of the rules might result in warnings, kicks, mutes or bans.
